To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of autoencoder improves botnet detection.

1) the autoencoder improves upon detection when compared to hand-crafted features and is comparable to the filter encoder; 2) the filter encoder improves upon detection when hand-crafted feature and autoencoder are compared; 3) the denoising autoencoders improves upon detection when both hand-crafted features, autoencoder and filter encoder are compared.

the use of autoencoders to generate a low-dimensional embedding of flow data improves detection of botnet traffic, and that the use of a filter encoding and denoise autoencoders improves detection of bot traffic when noise is added to the data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the representation of botnet traffic using an autoencoder.
the use of autoencoders to represent botnet flow data and improve detection of botnet traffic.
using autoencoding to represent network traffic and the impact this has on the detection of malicious activity in a network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
autoencoding improves detection performance and is comparable to the performance of the state-of-the-art.
autoencoder-based methods can be used to improve detection of botnets in network flow data, but the best approach is still to be determined.
autoencoding is an effective approach to feature engineering and can improve detection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the autoencoder, denoising auto-encoder, or filter encoding, all improve the detection of botnets in network flows.
autoencoding improves upon hand-crafted features for botnets detection.
the use of autoencoding for feature engineering in the detection of botnets from flow data is promising and worth pursuing further.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have successfully used autoencoders to represent network flow data.
the autoencoder can be a useful tool in the detection of botnet traffic.

the autoencoder is a promising tool for feature engineering and that it is worth investigating the use of autoencoders in other contexts where hand-crafted features dominate the detection of malicious traffic.
